A

Both responses correctly identify the main bug: OFFSET combined with deletion skips rows. Both also cover crash safety and idempotency, and both note the string comparison on `created_at`. Response A adds the missing-rollback issue (an exception during archive or delete leaves the transaction open), which Response B omits. Response A is also somewhat tighter, and both responses run somewhat past the 200-word limit. Response B's suggestion to increase batch size to reduce commits is weaker advice here.
